# Controlled design-partner beta fixtures

These cases are redacted or synthetic and exercise proof boundaries. They are
not evidence that a real capture, physical robot task, deployment, safety
certification, or comparative policy ranking succeeded.

`fixture_matrix.json` is the finite required-case index. Production contract
tests materialize the capture cases into Capture Intake Envelope and Capture QA
inputs and bind the remaining cases to their reconstruction, task-intent,
placement, and Decision Envelope invariants. The frozen comparative policy
ranking verdict is `thesis_not_supported`.
